scripts.name: Set up new worktree
scripts.command: { test -e .envrc || { test -e "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/.envrc" && cp -P "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/.envrc" .; } || ln -s .envrc.project .envrc; } && { test -e .env || ! test -e "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/.env" || cp -P "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/.env" .; } && direnv allow && direnv exec . true
